settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Desktop Settings
settings.languageDescription: Select the display language for the application.
settings.getStartedDesc: Welcome to Music Desktop App. Adjust settings and personalize your experience.
settings.enableAutostartDesc: Launch YouTube Music when you sign in.
settings.minimizeToTrayDesc: Close window to tray instead of quitting.
settings.disableHwAccelDesc: Requires an app restart to apply.
settings.sentryDesc: Help improve the app by sharing anonymized crash data.
settings.allowErrorReportingDesc: Allows faster bug fixing via anonymized error reports.
settings.devDesc: Advanced tools for debugging. Do not paste unknown scripts into the console.
settings.enableDevDesc: Enables developer tools for testing additional functionality.

playerSection.title: Player
playerSection.expVolumeDesc: Use an exponential volume curve for finer control than the default linear slider.
playerSection.taskbarProgressDesc: Show playback progress on the taskbar.
playerSection.chromecastDesc: Show YouTube Music Cast and talk to devices on this LAN. Restart required. Firewall must allow mDNS.
playerSection.sharedLinksDesc: How ytmd:// links open and how YouTube Music share URLs are rewritten.
playerSection.openLinkDesc: How ytmd:// share links behave when the app receives them.
playerSection.askFirstDesc: Choose play now, add to queue, or cancel
playerSection.playImmediateDesc: Start the track without a confirmation dialog
playerSection.replaceShareDesc: Rewrite the share dialog URL to ytmd:// so Copy opens this app.
